# ADR 0004: Bounded state: in-memory windows with eviction, Redis when multi-instance

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Mobile money fraud rules engine

## Context

Stateful rules can exhaust memory over millions of events.

## Decision

Keep per-account windows bounded by simulated time and evict; switch to Redis sorted sets for multi-instance real time.

## Consequences

Stable heap; horizontal scaling path.

## Alternatives considered

Unbounded maps (OOM).
